page.overview:
Who is Bellamy?

Bellamy "the Hyena" is a dyer and retired pirate hailing from the North Blue.

Originally captain of the former Bellamy Pirates, he was renowned in Mock Town as the "Big-Time Rookie" until his humiliating defeat by Monkey D. Luffy. Desperate to redeem himself to his idol Donquixote Doflamingo, he worked back up as a full-fledged member of the Donquixote Pirates, until the crew was entirely destroyed in Dressrosa by the Straw Hat Pirates.

He is the main antagonist of the Jaya Arc, and a minor antagonist in the Dressrosa Arc. He is also given some focus in the The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet cover arc.

Bellamy is a tall, muscular man with tan skin and short, unkempt blond hair. During the Jaya Arc, he wore white pants, a green sash with markings, and a pink sleeveless shirt with a navy blue pirate captain's coat over it. The coat tended to fall off whenever Bellamy used his spring-based jumping.
